source.title: MapLibre GL JS official plugin catalog

connections.title: Local county and feature search bridge
connections.reason: KFM already owns a bounded feature search index, so a Carmen GeoJSON adapter can add MapLibre geocoder ergonomics without introducing a live third-party geocoding dependency.
connections.connection: SEARCH_INDEX → Carmen GeoJSON adapter → MapLibre geocoder control
connections.gate: Admit the package, implement deterministic forward geocoding, preserve keyboard parity, and test empty, denied, and ambiguous outcomes.
connections.fallback: Keep the existing KFM search interface authoritative until the adapter and browser probes pass.

connections.title: PMTiles release-carrier connection
connections.reason: Single-file range-readable tiles fit KFM's versioned, immutable public-carrier model and reduce server coupling.
connections.connection: Released PMTiles artifact + manifest + range transport → package-owned addProtocol adapter
connections.gate: Require admitted archive identity, hashes, range/CORS proof, cache and expiry rules, correction propagation, and rollback evidence.
connections.fallback: Continue site-local GeoJSON fixtures and display readiness only.

connections.title: Swipe comparison connection
connections.reason: A synchronized swipe view matches KFM's existing A/B comparison concepts when both sides retain independent evidence and release identity.
connections.connection: Compatible release A + compatible release B → synchronized MapLibre comparison control
connections.gate: Admit an aligned pair, preserve independent citations and time axes, add camera-sync and accessibility probes, and prevent visual difference from becoming an unsupported claim.
connections.fallback: Use the current textual comparison eligibility and report-scope views.

connections.title: Area-of-interest drawing connection
connections.reason: A maintained draw adapter can replace ad hoc geometry tools and feed bounded report extents without granting drawn shapes evidence authority.
connections.connection: MapLibre draw interaction → validated public-safe AOI geometry → report context only
connections.gate: Define geometry limits, keyboard editing, topology validation, sensitive-area handling, serialization, and deterministic clear/reset behavior.
connections.fallback: Retain the current bounded analysis-area interaction.

connections.title: Evidence-preserving map export connection
connections.reason: Image and PDF export is useful only when the visual artifact remains paired with citations, time, release identity, redaction, and limitations.
connections.connection: Rendered MapLibre view + KFM export manifest → governed image/PDF package
connections.gate: Prove attribution continuity, font and worker behavior, deterministic extent, redaction, metadata sidecar generation, and no publication side effects.
connections.fallback: Keep the existing public-safe JSON export review as the authoritative export path.

connections.title: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF connection
connections.reason: COG range access is a logical carrier for versioned elevation, land-cover, and historical raster evidence without pre-tiling every source.
connections.connection: Admitted COG + manifest + range transport → MapLibre raster protocol
connections.gate: Verify projection, nodata, overviews, range/CORS behavior, rights, scale, color interpretation, performance, and 2D evidence parity.
connections.fallback: Use synthetic elevation bands and existing generalized raster concepts only.

connections.title: Derived contour connection
connections.reason: Contours can make admitted DEM context legible, but they are derived products whose interval, source, units, and uncertainty must stay explicit.
connections.connection: Admitted DEM carrier → deterministic contour derivation → styled MapLibre line layer
connections.gate: Close DEM admission first, then validate derivation parameters, units, caching, accessibility, performance, and evidence lineage.
connections.fallback: Retain the non-topographic synthetic elevation concept.

connections.title: Development-only source inspection
connections.reason: An inspect control can accelerate source-layer and property debugging but must never expose protected properties or become a public raw-data backdoor.
connections.connection: Development renderer state → redacted inspection control → diagnostic evidence
connections.gate: Limit to non-production builds, apply explicit property allowlists, redact URLs and tokens, and add negative tests for protected data.
connections.fallback: Use the current redacted diagnostics workbench.

connections.title: High-volume analytical overlay connection
connections.reason: GPU analytical overlays are useful for dense flows and aggregates only after KFM has a released, scale-appropriate dataset that exceeds native style-layer needs.
connections.connection: Released aggregate carrier → package-owned deck.gl custom-layer adapter → MapLibre camera
connections.gate: Demonstrate a real performance need, preserve picking-to-evidence identity, test WebGL resource cleanup, and supply an accessible non-canvas alternative.
connections.fallback: Prefer native MapLibre sources and layers for the current starter slice.
